interactions.objectiveFacts: During my 5-minute presentation on database migration milestones, Alex interrupted after 45 seconds, stating: "We already know this is delayed, let's skip to someone who has updates." When I noted that milestones were actually ahead of schedule, Alex rolled eyes and began typing on phone without responding.
interactions.impactNotes: Cut off presentation prematurely; resulted in team confusion regarding true migration timeline until clarified via Slack afterward.
interactions.actionTaken: Followed up on Slack with full slide deck to team to ensure transparent timeline.
interactions.evidenceDescription: Slack thread sharing the slides with timestamps confirming presentation was cut short.

interactions.objectiveFacts: While getting coffee, Alex approached and said: "Must be nice to have so much free time that you can rewrite entire modules instead of doing actual roadmap work." I asked what specific roadmap item was missing, and Alex responded: "If you need me to explain your job to you, maybe you shouldn't be in it," and walked out.
interactions.impactNotes: Unprovoked personal hostility with no witnesses. Kept heart rate elevated, had to take a 15-minute walk before resuming work.
interactions.actionTaken: Recorded immediate contemporaneous note; avoided further unobserved 1-on-1 conversations.
interactions.evidenceDescription: Direct verbal encounter; logged within 15 minutes of occurrence.

interactions.impactNotes: Deliberate information withholding designed to misrepresent ownership to senior leadership.
interactions.actionTaken: Replied to Director with link to original proposal document dated two weeks prior.
